comment: Projects shown in the homepage 'What I'm working on' section. Only listed projects are read. t3Project is the T3 Code project title; repo is the local checkout on the dev host. Never add a repoUrl for a private repository.
titlesComment: Display titles to rename (string) or hide (null) on the homepage, matched case-insensitively against the title the generator would show. Use it for subjects that only make sense inside the project or that repeat another project's item; hide rather than guess at a rename.

titles.Keep available work capacity in the boar: Show available work capacity in the board toolbar
